# Third-party notices

Generated from the installed npm dependency tree and locked Rust metadata used for the build. Includes build-time dependencies as well as runtime components. Verbatim license/notice files are included when present at package root or in a licenses directory. Regenerate on each target before release; this inventory is not a complete legal audit. Python packages and model weights are downloaded at first launch, retain their own licensing, and are not redistributed in this installer.
